# Darklight Chess Academy

> Darklight Chess Academy is a chess academy based in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India. It teaches live online chess classes to students worldwide and offline classes at two centres in Coimbatore, for children and adults from complete beginner to tournament level.

Key facts (as published on this website):
- Founder: Karuppasamy. Co-founder and Head Coach: Manikandan.
- Formats: live online classes (group batches, private 1-to-1 lessons, sibling classes) and offline classes in Coimbatore.
- Online batches: standard India-timing batches plus an international batch for other time zones.
- Levels: beginner, intermediate, advanced and tournament preparation.
- Enrolment starts with a free demo class and level assessment. Lessons start from ₹1,000 per hour (INR); the first demo class is free and siblings get a discount. Class timings are flexible and set in the student's local time.
- Offline centres: 4th Street, NSR Rd, Saibaba Colony, Coimbatore 641011; VV Complex, 14, Sowripalayam Rd, Rukmani Nagar, Coimbatore 641028.
- Contact: +91 83001 55259 (phone / WhatsApp), darklightchess64@gmail.com

## United States and Canada
- Classes for US and Canadian students are live online, taught in English, as small groups, one-to-one or sibling classes.
- US and Canadian class times: weekdays about 4–8 pm in the family's own time zone (Eastern to Pacific, and Atlantic and Newfoundland time in Canada), plus weekend mornings. Coaches teach these slots in the early morning in India.
- Daytime classes are available for homeschooling families, because North American daytime is evening in India.
- Fees: from ₹1,000 per hour, about US$11 or CA$15 at recent exchange rates (indicative; set in INR). Sibling discount. First demo class free, with a level assessment.
- Tournament preparation for US Chess–rated, scholastic and state events, and CFC-rated events in Canada.
- Student results in North America include 1st place at the USA Chess Festival (Harinandan), 1st place in a Silver Knight tournament and a state-level title (Aayush), play at the Continental Chess Concord Tournament in California (Harinanthan), and a tournament win in Canada.
- Pages: [Online chess classes in the USA](https://www.darklightchess.com/online-chess-classes-usa/) · [Online chess classes in Canada](https://www.darklightchess.com/online-chess-classes-canada/) · [Homeschool chess classes](https://www.darklightchess.com/homeschool-chess-classes/) · [Chess classes for young kids, ages 4–7](https://www.darklightchess.com/chess-classes-for-young-kids/)
- Parent guides: [Chess lesson costs in the US](https://www.darklightchess.com/blog/how-much-do-chess-lessons-cost-in-the-us/) · [Chess lesson costs in Canada](https://www.darklightchess.com/blog/how-much-do-chess-lessons-cost-in-canada/) · [US Chess ratings explained](https://www.darklightchess.com/blog/us-chess-ratings-explained-for-parents/) · [CFC ratings explained](https://www.darklightchess.com/blog/cfc-ratings-explained-for-parents/) · [How to choose an online chess coach](https://www.darklightchess.com/blog/how-to-choose-an-online-chess-coach/) · [Private vs group chess lessons](https://www.darklightchess.com/blog/private-vs-group-chess-lessons/) · [Are online chess classes effective?](https://www.darklightchess.com/blog/are-online-chess-classes-effective/)
- The academy has no offices or centres in the US or Canada; all North American coaching is online.
